question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"benefits"** means advantages or profits gained from something. (लाभ)

 
 
• **Example: **The new policy provides numerous** benefits** to the employees.
 
 
 
• **"burdens" **refers to something that is heavy to bear, causing worry or difficulty. (बोझ)
 
 
• **Example: **He carried the** burdens** of his responsibilities with great care.
 
 
 
• Here in this given sentence from the passage, there is a sense of profit for the humanity or society. So, the word **'benefits**' is perfect here.
 
• We can infer that the correct word to fill in blank (number 4) is **'benefits'**.

Hence the correct statement is 'the reality is that education is a public good that** benefits** everyone in society.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sections **(अनुभाग): Distinct parts into which something is divided.

 
 
• **Example:** The book is divided into several **sections** for easy understanding.
 
 
 
• **Emphasizes **(ज़ोर देना): To give special importance or prominence to something.
 
 
• **Example: **She **emphasizes** the need for immediate action.
 
 
 
• **Burdens** (बोझ): Something that is heavy to bear, causing worry or difficulty.
 
 
• **Example:** He carried the **burdens **of his responsibilities with great care.
